components.name: Glyph
components.description: An item's head and beam; line form shows state: dashed planned, solid live, hollow done.
components.css: .ds-glyph-row { display: flex; gap: 16px; } .ds-glyph { position: relative; display: block; width: 44px; height: 16px; color: var(--ink, #1c1b22); } .ds-beam { position: absolute; left: 6px; right: 0; top: 5px; height: 7px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-head { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 2px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-planned .ds-beam { border: 0; height: 6px; top: 5.5px; border-radius: 0; background: repeating-linear-gradient(to right, currentColor 0 7px, transparent 7px 11px); } .ds-live { color: var(--accent, #0a675a); } .ds-live .ds-beam { background: currentColor; height: 9px; top: 4px; } .ds-done { color: var(--ink-3, #625e55); } .ds-done .ds-head { background: var(--paper, #ebe4d4); border: 1.5px solid currentColor; box-sizing: border-box; }

components.name: Public Primary Button
components.description: Verdigris Start with today; the only accent-filled button.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent, #0a675a); color: var(--on-accent, #f3eee1); font: 600 15px var(--font-sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif); transition: background-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent, #0a675a) 86%, var(--ink, #1c1b22)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0a675a); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ink Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--ink, #1c1b22); color: var(--paper, #ebe4d4); font: 500 14px var(--font-sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0a675a); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(28,27,34,0.28)); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #1c1b22); font: 500 14px var(--font-sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent-wash, rgba(10,103,90,0.14)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0a675a); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Capture Field

components.html: C
components.css: .ds-capture { position: relative; max-width: 440px; } .ds-capture-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 10px 40px 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--field, rgba(28,27,34,0.55)); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--sheet, #f3eee1); color: var(--ink, #1c1b22); font: 14px var(--font-sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif); caret-color: var(--accent, #0a675a); } .ds-capture-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3, #625e55); } .ds-capture-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0a675a); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-kbd { position: absolute; right: 10px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(28,27,34,0.28)); border-radius: 4px; font: 600 12px var(--font-sans, sans-serif); color: var(--ink-3, #625e55); }

components.name: Item Chip
components.description: An untimed item in Any time or Waiting; draggable onto a staff.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(28,27,34,0.28)); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--sheet, #f3eee1); color: var(--ink, #1c1b22); font: 500 14px var(--font-sans, sans-serif); cursor: grab; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--field, rgba(28,27,34,0.55)); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0a675a); outline-offset: 3px; border-color: var(--accent, #0a675a); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent, #0a675a); } .ds-chip-glyph { width: 28px; height: 6px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(to right, currentColor 0 7px, transparent 7px 11px); border-radius: 0; }

components.html: 131413:41
components.css: .ds-axis { position: relative; height: 90px; width: 200px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(28,27,34,0.28)); } .ds-tick { position: absolute; top: 0; height: 34px; padding: 9px 0 0 6px; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(28,27,34,0.28)); font: 500 12px/1 var(--font-sans, sans-serif); color: var(--ink-3, #625e55); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-flag { position: absolute; top: 5px; transform: translateX(-50%); padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--accent, #0a675a); color: var(--on-accent, #f3eee1); font: 600 12px/1 var(--font-sans, sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; z-index: 1; } .ds-playhead { position: absolute; top: 34px; bottom: 0; width: 2px; margin-left: -1px; background: var(--accent, #0a675a); }

narrative.northStar: The Day as a Printed Score
narrative.overview:
Axiis draws a day the way an engraver sets a page of chamber music. Each area of life (Work, Home, Health) is a staff of five faint ruled lines. One hour axis runs across every staff, with a barline on each hour and a double barline where the day ends. Items are beams laid on those lines, and their line form, not a colour, says where they stand: dashed while planned, solid while happening, hollow once done. A single verdigris playhead marks now.

The surface is warm music paper in light and a deep ink-blue night in dark, both on one set of shared tokens. Depth comes from hairlines and tonal paper steps, almost never from shadow. Type pairs Besley, a bookish serif with high contrast, for headings, staff names and the wordmark, with Hanken Grotesk for everything a hand operates. The interface is quiet by default and spacious, and its one loud moment is the colour of now.
keyCharacteristics: One hour axis shared by every area, read left to right.
State is drawn as line form; colour is reserved.
Verdigris appears only for now, a drag target, the focused or selected thing, and the one public call to start (Start with today).
Engraved hairlines and paper tones carry structure; shadows are rare and functional.
Serif for what you read, sans for what you operate, tabular figures for every time and count.

rules.name: The Now Rule
rules.body: Verdigris means now, a drag target, or the focused or selected thing. It never marks an item type, an area, a category or a success message. A screen with no now and nothing focused carries almost no verdigris.

rules.name: The Ink-for-Selection Rule
rules.body: The current navigation item and the active segment of a toggle are filled with ink, not verdigris. Place in the app is shown in ink; verdigris is kept for time and focus.

rules.name: The No-Type-Hue Rule
rules.body: PRODUCT.md allowed a small set of item-type hues. The shipped system uses none. Type is shown by glyph shape (see Components), so do not introduce type colours without revisiting that decision.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Every <time>, clock, count and date numeral uses tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, set globally on time and .tabular). Times never jitter as they change.

rules.name: The Serif Reads, Sans Operates Rule
rules.body: Besley is for names and headings a person reads. Buttons, inputs, labels and metadata are always Hanken Grotesk.

rules.name: The Engraved Line Rule
rules.body: If a boundary is needed, draw a hairline. A double barline (3px double Hairline) closes the end of the day and the landing's three-measure strip. Never use a shadow to separate two things that sit on the same page.

dos: Do show an item's state with its line form: dashed planned, solid live, hollow done.
Do reserve Verdigris (#0a675a, dark #45c7b0) for now, a drag target, focus or selection, and the public Start with today.
Do fill the current navigation item with Engraving Ink, not verdigris.
Do draw structure with Hairline (28% ink) and Hairline Soft (12% ink), and close the end of a sequence with a 3px double rule.
Do set every time, count and date numeral in tabular figures.
Do use the house curve cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for movement, and drop the movement under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep copy quiet and plain: sentence case, no exclamation marks, no guilt about overdue items ("Waiting", "For things that belong to the day but not to an hour.").
donts: Don't colour-code item types or areas; type is the glyph's head shape.
Don't use verdigris for success, decoration, icons or headings.
Don't add shadows to cards or rows; only floating layers (the palette, a dragged chip) are lifted.
Don't set controls, labels or metadata in Besley.
Don't add gradients beyond the ruled-line patterns that draw staves and dashes.
Don't use exclamation marks, streaks, overdue reds or productivity-guru copy.
